name: 达伦·保罗·菲舍
name_full: 达伦·保罗·菲舍 Darren Paul Fisher
introduction: Darren Paul Fisher is an award-winning screenwriter, director and producer, and the Head of Directing in the department of Film, Screen and Creative Media at Bond University. In 2018, he was the recipient of the Greg Coote Scholarship, awarded by Screen Queensland and Australians in Film to a screen practitioner with a successful track record of creating compelling drama for the screen.Darren works across both the large and small screens, making his feature film debut writing, producing and directing Inbetweeners (Universal Pictures) and more recently the science-fiction mystery Frequencies, now being adapted as television series. He currently developing a variety of projects with various industry partners and has recently completed his PhD, a reconceptualization of mainstream narrative feature filmmaking.
